ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to validate Loanapp Reference field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Opportunity', NOT(REGEX(Loanapp_Reference__c, "^APP-\\d+$")), NOT(ISBLANK(Loanapp_Reference__c)), NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Loanapp Reference must start with 'APP-' followed by a number.
